note: Role -> model and effort. Override per stage with /audit <stage> --models role=model[:effort],... Workflows never name a model; they read args.models[role].

finder_critical.use: rust/frontend/perf/stability lenses in critical batches (B3a, B3b, B4a, B4b, B5)

judge_high.use: audit-judge for P0/P1 or a dispute (static and QA)

qa_planner.use: QA plan from the catalog plus targeted QA-T suites

qa_tester.use: qa-tester in blocks S1, S3, S4

qa_refuter_safety.use: qa-refuter for S2 and data-safety bugs

clerk.use: audit-clerk: tool runner, sweep, static dedup, session start/wait/stop, triage, guard
